plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Riverbed SteelHead WAN optimization device. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, temperature, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 17163).
name: Wanopt

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the one-minute rolling CPU utilization of the Riverbed SteelHead (STEELHEAD-MIB cpuUtil1) as a 0-100 percentage aggregated across all CPUs. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate optimization-service overload or an admission-control condition.

metrics.name: device_cpu_load1
metrics.description: This metric reports the one-minute CPU load of the Riverbed SteelHead (STEELHEAD-MIB cpuLoad1). The raw OID is hundredths of load and is divided by 100 for display. This is not a percentage.

metrics.name: device_cpu_load5
metrics.description: This metric reports the five-minute CPU load of the Riverbed SteelHead (STEELHEAD-MIB cpuLoad5). The raw OID is hundredths of load and is divided by 100 for display. This is not a percentage.

metrics.name: device_cpu_load15
metrics.description: This metric reports the fifteen-minute CPU load of the Riverbed SteelHead (STEELHEAD-MIB cpuLoad15). The raw OID is hundredths of load and is divided by 100 for display. This is not a percentage.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports the SteelHead system temperature (STEELHEAD-MIB systemTemperature) in degrees Celsius. Sustained high temperature can indicate cooling failure or an overheated environment.

metrics.name: device_health_state
metrics.description: This metric reports SteelHead system health (STEELHEAD-MIB systemHealth). Raw codes healthy=10000, degraded=30000, admissionControl=31000 and critical=50000 are normalized to 1=healthy and 2=not-healthy. A value greater than 1 indicates degraded, admission-control or critical health.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
